description: This file defines several React functional components used for displaying textual content, headings, a link button, and styled pill elements within a web application's preferences UI. It includes component props, styling logic, and references external style and utility functions.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: A React component rendering a styled heading (h2) with optional classes.

methods.name: Subtitle
methods.description: A React component rendering a styled heading (h4) with optional classes.

methods.name: SubtitleLight
methods.description: A React component rendering a less bold styled heading (h4).

methods.name: Text
methods.description: A React component rendering a paragraph with specific styling.

methods.name: LinkButton
methods.description: A React component rendering an anchor element styled as a button that opens a link, with optional click handler.

methods.name: Pill
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled div with color variant based on the 'style' prop.
